decision.rationale: Rejected: 1 threads per HT encode block did not improve representative end-to-end encode throughput relative to 128. No priority B16 confidence-interval support. The one-thread tiny RGB128 gain does not establish a general size rule. Production remains 128; the temporary process-local launch switch was removed. Matrix and independent parity coverage retained. Timings are rounded Criterion mean estimates with 95% intervals from logs; three separate processes ran in order 128, 32, 1 without randomized repetitions. B16 uses sixteen sequential public encodes and required about 20.5 seconds for 15 samples despite the requested 3-second target. Synthetic patterned inputs, three DWT levels, 64x64 blocks, HT cleanup, host input and host output with one warm reused accelerator per cell. Startup excluded. The corpus digest identifies the priority input; each item is framed by a little-endian u64 byte length. Commands, hardware, trace findings, test-contract correction and limitations are in P26-cuda-ht-launch-notes.md.
